text: [excited] This car's new update shows you the road... like a video game!
On Saturday, Tesla began rolling out self-driving version fifteen.
[curious] The screen now shows your car from a floating camera, with AI filling in the gaps.
It spots potholes... and it slows down for speed cameras.
[deadpan] Unless you override it twice at the same camera. Then it just... stops slowing down there.
[playfully] It also claims a twenty-five times improvement... but shared no actual numbers.
[cheerful] Would you trust it? Send this to the friend who drives like it's a video game.
